evaluation_policy.product_code: Fixed at evaluated_product_sha; no product-code edits during evaluation
evaluation_policy.freeze: Question, expected claims, values, source references and tolerance are immutable after freeze_commit
evaluation_policy.invalid: A demonstrably wrong or ambiguous frozen task is recorded as INVALID with reason; its question and gold are never edited
evaluation_policy.track_a: Identical valid tasks: Agent with local qwen3:8b, hybrid Chroma 12 documents/18976 chunks, web off, autonomous Python; Qwen and OpenAI closed-book without retrieval or tools
evaluation_policy.track_b: Qwen and OpenAI receive exactly the Agent's captured KB/FIG text evidence for each task, with no new retrieval, browsing, or tools; Agent rows are reused from Track A
evaluation_policy.figure_evidence: Text baselines receive the Agent's retrieved figure note text, not image pixels; source gold was visually checked from existing images
evaluation_policy.agent_calculation_goal_success: Correct numeric result and unit, correct exact formula-source span when KB formula is required, complete provenance chain, validation_passed CALC, and appropriate action sequence are all required
evaluation_policy.false_premise_goal_success: Explicit rejection, corrected engineering relation and semantically supporting evidence citation are all required
evaluation_policy.scoring: Deterministic gates plus structured expected-claim comparison plus single-reviewer AI-assisted semantic adjudication; reviewer separated from the candidate OpenAI mini model when available
evaluation_policy.statistics: Task-paired nonparametric bootstrap percentile 95% CI, 4000 resamples, seed 20261010
evaluation_policy.missing_provider_results: Provider errors are not task invalidity; incomplete system tracks remain explicitly incomplete and cannot be ranked as complete
evaluation_policy.output_driven_changes: No product tuning, benchmark answer edits or frozen-task replacement based on observed model outputs
